work_history.title: Account Development Representative
work_history.description: B2B sales supporting APAC and EMEA region. Prospect utilities and Independent Power Producers (IPPs) and book meetings to discuss softwares such as ADMS, SCADA, DMS, and DERMS. Initiate outreach by calls, emails, and LinkedIn to invite prospects to conferences and company events. Develop and nurture business opportunities, by doing regular check-ins. Collaborate with Regional Sales Manager partners to identify industry gaps, improve outreach strategies, and identify high quality prospects. Very familiar with CRM tool Salesforce and Tableau.

work_history.title: Senior Sales Operations Supervisor
work_history.description: Collaborate with Account Managers to drive renewal upsell opportunities and implement strategies to reduce customer attrition. Partner with Account Executives and Sales Development Reps in identifying new business opportunities to expand customer base. Lead team to achieve sales targets and improve performance. Track and analyze sales metrics to identify areas for improvement. Provide training and coaching opportunities for team members. Collaborate with the team to develop and implement effective sales strategies.

work_history.title: Operations Manager
work_history.description: Manage day-to-day operations to ensure efficiency and effectiveness in service delivery. Led and developed a team of supervisors and staff to meet operational goals and improve performance. Identify and implement process improvements to enhance service quality and operational efficiency.

work_history.title: Senior Operations Supervisor
work_history.description: Lead and develop Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) who support the nesting phase, ensuring they are equipped to provide effective guidance and support. Conduct coaching and call listening sessions with agents to identify and address performance gaps effectively.

work_history.title: Training Supervisor
work_history.description: Evaluate the effectiveness of training programs through assessments and feedback. Maintained accurate records of training activities and outcomes, and reporting on training effectiveness to management. Lead and mentor a team of trainers to ensure high-quality training delivery.

work_history.title: Trainer
work_history.description: Conduct training sessions to educate employees about telco products. Monitor the impact of training on employee performance and product knowledge. Launched and trained Wave 1 for largest US voice telco program.

work_history.title: Customer Service Agent
work_history.description: Assist customers with account-related tasks, such as billing inquiries and plan upgrades. Perform troubleshooting and resolving customer issues efficiently. Identify opportunities to promote additional services that meet customer needs.

work_history.title: Inside Sales Executive
work_history.description: Conduct inbound and outbound B2B sales for Singapore Logistics business account. Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and new clients to increase revenue. Negotiate and close sales deals to meet or exceed sales targets. Process client orders and sending invoices for payments.
